Privacy policy

Last updated November 16, 2026

Rello helps you write and tailor your resume. To do that we store what you put in it. This page explains what we keep, why, and how to delete it.

What we store
Your account: your email address, and your name if you add it or sign in with Google.
Your resumes and tailored copies, exactly as you write them.
Job descriptions you paste in, kept with the tailored copy they produced.
A log of each AI request (what kind, when, and how much text) so we can keep usage fair and costs down.
Your credit balance, credit usage, and payment references, amounts, currencies and payment status.
What we don't keep
Files you import. We read the text out of your PDF or DOCX and then discard the file.
PDFs you download. They're generated from your saved resume each time.
AI processing

When you tailor a resume, ask for a rewrite, or import a file, the relevant text is sent to an AI model through OpenRouter to produce suggestions. We send only what that task needs. We don't use your resumes to train models or for marketing.

Where it lives

Paystack processes payments. We send your email, the pack amount, currency and order reference to open checkout. Rello does not receive or store your full card details. Payment records retained by Paystack are handled under Paystack’s own privacy policy.

Your data is stored with Supabase, our database provider, and only your account can read it. If you use Rello as a guest, your resumes are tied to that browser until you sign in.

Deleting your data

You can delete any resume from your list, or delete your whole account and everything in it from Settings. Deletion is permanent. Credit and generation records are deleted with your account. We remove your account link from retained purchase records; Paystack keeps its own payment records under its policy.

Terms of service

Last updated November 16, 2026

By using Rello you agree to these terms.

Your content

Your resumes are yours. You give us permission to store and process them only to run Rello for you: saving, tailoring, improving and exporting them.

Be truthful

Rello is built to work only from what you tell it, and suggests changes rather than making them. You're responsible for what goes on your resume. Review every suggestion before you use it, and don't add experience you don't have.

No guarantees

We work hard to make Rello useful, but we can't promise interviews, job offers, or that any particular hiring system will read your resume a certain way. AI suggestions can be wrong.

Fair use

Verified accounts receive 10 free tailoring credits once. One credit is used when a tailored copy with useful suggestions is saved. Failed attempts and results with no suggested changes don’t spend credits. Each tailored copy includes 10 successful AI retries. Editing and re-downloading saved resumes are free.

Credit purchases

Credit packs are one-time purchases, not subscriptions, and credits do not expire. The checkout shows the amount and currency before you pay. Paystack processes payment, and credits are added after payment is verified. Reversed payments remove the associated credits, including credits already spent; a resulting balance adjustment is covered by future credits. This does not limit any refund or consumer rights that apply to you.

Import and general AI writing help have a daily limit. Tailoring uses your credits and the retry allowance for each copy. Request rate limits keep the service available for everyone. Don't try to get around it, overload the service, or use Rello to process content that isn't yours.

Changes

If these terms change, we'll update this page and the date above.

Getting started

From your first resume to a copy that fits the job. Here’s how to make the most of Rello.

Create or import your resume

Open Your resumes and start with a template, or choose Import to bring in a PDF or Word document. Imports support PDF and DOCX files under 5 MB. A text-based file works best.

Check the imported details before continuing. Make sure your name, roles, dates, education, and skills are correct. You can open one section at a time while the preview updates beside it.

Tailor a copy to a job

From your resume, choose Tailor for a job and paste the job description. Include the responsibilities and requirements so Rello has enough context. Job title and company are optional.

Tailoring creates a separate copy. Your original resume stays available for the next application.

Understand the job match

Sign in to receive 10 free tailoring credits, once per account. A saved tailored copy costs one credit and includes 10 successful AI retries. Failed requests don’t use credits. Editing and downloading are free. View your balance and add a one-time pack in Credits & payments.

The match compares the job’s requirements with the experience you have already added:

On your resume: the requirement has supporting experience.
Partly: your resume shows some relevant experience, but may need more detail.
Missing: Rello could not find supporting experience in your resume.

Use this as a review checklist. Add detail only when it reflects something you actually did.

Review each suggestion

Compare the original wording with the proposed change. Removed text and added text are highlighted so you can see the difference.

Use suggestion applies the change to your tailored copy.
Keep original keeps your wording.
Try again asks for another suggestion.

Read every change, including names, numbers, and claims about your work. AI can make mistakes, and you decide what belongs on your resume.

Choose a template and download

You can switch between the four templates without rewriting your content. Check the preview, then choose Download PDF. If you are asked to sign in, use Google or an email code to continue.

If a download fails, check your connection and try again. For import problems, try a text-based PDF or DOCX instead of a scanned image.

Keep access to your work

Guest resumes are tied to the browser where you created them. Sign in to keep access to your saved work across devices.

Manage your account or delete your data in Settings. For details about how your content is handled, read the Privacy policy. You can also find answers to common questions on the landing page.

By using Rello you agree to these terms.

Your content

Your resumes are yours. You give us permission to store and process them only to run Rello for you: saving, tailoring, improving and exporting them.

Be truthful

Rello is built to work only from what you tell it, and suggests changes rather than making them. You're responsible for what goes on your resume. Review every suggestion before you use it, and don't add experience you don't have.

No guarantees

We work hard to make Rello useful, but we can't promise interviews, job offers, or that any particular hiring system will read your resume a certain way. AI suggestions can be wrong.

Fair use

Verified accounts receive 10 free tailoring credits once. One credit is used when a tailored copy with useful suggestions is saved. Failed attempts and results with no suggested changes don’t spend credits. Each tailored copy includes 10 successful AI retries. Editing and re-downloading saved resumes are free.

Credit purchases

Credit packs are one-time purchases, not subscriptions, and credits do not expire. The checkout shows the amount and currency before you pay. Paystack processes payment, and credits are added after payment is verified. Reversed payments remove the associated credits, including credits already spent; a resulting balance adjustment is covered by future credits. This does not limit any refund or consumer rights that apply to you.

Import and general AI writing help have a daily limit. Tailoring uses your credits and the retry allowance for each copy. Request rate limits keep the service available for everyone. Don't try to get around it, overload the service, or use Rello to process content that isn't yours.

Changes

If these terms change, we'll update this page and the date above.

Getting started

From your first resume to a copy that fits the job. Here’s how to make the most of Rello.

Create or import your resume

Open Your resumes and start with a template, or choose Import to bring in a PDF or Word document. Imports support PDF and DOCX files under 5 MB. A text-based file works best.

Check the imported details before continuing. Make sure your name, roles, dates, education, and skills are correct. You can open one section at a time while the preview updates beside it.

Tailor a copy to a job

From your resume, choose Tailor for a job and paste the job description. Include the responsibilities and requirements so Rello has enough context. Job title and company are optional.

Tailoring creates a separate copy. Your original resume stays available for the next application.

Understand the job match

Sign in to receive 10 free tailoring credits, once per account. A saved tailored copy costs one credit and includes 10 successful AI retries. Failed requests don’t use credits. Editing and downloading are free. View your balance and add a one-time pack in Credits & payments.

The match compares the job’s requirements with the experience you have already added:

On your resume: the requirement has supporting experience.
Partly: your resume shows some relevant experience, but may need more detail.
Missing: Rello could not find supporting experience in your resume.

Use this as a review checklist. Add detail only when it reflects something you actually did.

Review each suggestion

Compare the original wording with the proposed change. Removed text and added text are highlighted so you can see the difference.

Use suggestion applies the change to your tailored copy.
Keep original keeps your wording.
Try again asks for another suggestion.

Read every change, including names, numbers, and claims about your work. AI can make mistakes, and you decide what belongs on your resume.

Choose a template and download

You can switch between the four templates without rewriting your content. Check the preview, then choose Download PDF. If you are asked to sign in, use Google or an email code to continue.

If a download fails, check your connection and try again. For import problems, try a text-based PDF or DOCX instead of a scanned image.

Keep access to your work

Guest resumes are tied to the browser where you created them. Sign in to keep access to your saved work across devices.

Manage your account or delete your data in Settings. For details about how your content is handled, read the Privacy policy. You can also find answers to common questions on the landing page.
